node.title: Prepare workshop setup
node.instructions: Confirm the workshop topology recorded in .xcoding/xc-orchestration-runtime.json (workshop.topology), its config entry, and the project-local facts required by WORKFLOW.md and KNOWLEDGE.md.
node.deliverables: Confirmed workshop topology and setup inputs recorded in the blackboard and setup artifacts.
node.acceptance: The workshop.topology config entry is recorded and consistent with the workshop worktree, and required project-local facts are available or gated.

node.title: Finalize workshop setup
node.instructions: Verify WORKFLOW.md and KNOWLEDGE.md through xc-document and record both as setup artifacts.
node.acceptance: Both workshop documents validate and their document-evolution subtrees are complete.
